calculators.name: Hydroforming - Hydroform
calculators.description: Hydroforming on the press, per part: Loading, Deep Draw / Fluid Cell Forming, Clean Tooling, Hand Adjusting, Visual Inspection and Unloading (memory/Sheetmetal Hydroforming operations). Deep Draw handles, forms and cleans the tool once per draw (one press cycle each); Fluid Cell forms the parts on its tray together, so the press cycle, the cleaning and the throw pad are shared by the parts per tray. Hand adjusting and the inspection are once per part.

source.engine: unloading_time_s (tblMaterialHandling at the formed part's weight)
draws (Deep Draw: the draws drawReductionPercentage needs; Fluid Cell: 1)
parts_per_cycle (Fluid Cell: Hydroforming - Parts per tray; Deep Draw: 1)

fields.name: Press Time
fields.formula: ({Forming Cycle Time} + {Clean Tooling Time} + {Throw Pad Time}) * {Draws} / {Parts per Cycle}

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Handling Time} + {Press Time} + {Hand Adjusting Time} + {Inspection Time}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Offline blank
calculators.description: Offline Blank, per blank: one stroke blanks the outline and pierces the holes in the flat (memory operations Blanking//Blank, Piercing//SimpleHole, Piercing//ComplexHole). A stroke is the press's own cycle or the time the strip takes to advance one blank (pressMaterialAdvanceRate by the blank's feed length), whichever is longer, plus the press's handling of the blank (its handling coefficients, from the reference exports).

source.engine: strokes_per_minute (pressMaterialAdvanceRate at the blank's feed length)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Stroke Time} + {Mass Handling Coefficient} * {Blank Mass} + {Constant Handling Time}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Clean tooling
calculators.description: Clean Tooling, per press cycle: the tool's surface (the part's developed area, the surface it is formed against) at the manual clean rate of tblCleanRate for that area, never under minimumToolCleanTime.

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Throw pad
calculators.description: The Fluid Cell throw pad, per press cycle: laid over the part's plan grown by throwPadAddendum on each side, applied and removed at their rates; used when requiredThrowPadDefault says so (not on Deep Draw).

fields.name: Pad Area
fields.formula: ({Part Length} + 2 * {Throw Pad Addendum}) * ({Part Width} + 2 * {Throw Pad Addendum})

fields.name: Throw Pad Time
fields.formula: {Throw Pad Used} * ({Pad Area} / {Application Rate} + {Pad Area} / {Removal Rate})

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Hand adjusting
calculators.description: Hand Adjusting, per part: the flanges the press cannot form (curved flanges turned beyond bendAngleFormingThreshold, or curved beyond excessiveCurvedFormThreshold) are formed by hand at defaultManualFormFormingRate along their length.

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Parts per tray
calculators.description: Fluid Cell parts per tray: each part sits in its hydroform holder (hydroformHolderGap and thicknessOfHydroformHolder around its plan); as many as the press's forming area holds, in either orientation, and no more than asked for (defaultNumPartPerFluidCellTray unless the Cost Guide sets more).

source.engine: tray_length_mm (the press's forming area; a round one, its inscribed square)
tray_width_mm (the press's forming area; a round one, its inscribed square)
requested_parts (the Cost Guide's parts per tray, else defaultNumPartPerFluidCellTray)

fields.name: Parts That Fit
fields.formula: max(floor({Tray Length} / {Footprint Length}) * floor({Tray Width} / {Footprint Width}), floor({Tray Length} / {Footprint Width}) * floor({Tray Width} / {Footprint Length}))

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Blanking force
calculators.description: The force of the offline blanking stroke: the blank's outline and the holes pierced with it, sheared through the sheet at the material's shear strength.

source.cad: pierced_hole_perimeter_mm (the holes pierced in the flat)

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Blank
calculators.description: The blank: the part's measured blank (its unfolded flat pattern, or a drawn part's developed area on its plan outline), grown on every side by blankAddendumWidth at the drawn depth for a drawn part (trimmed after forming); a part cut to its net shape has none.

source.engine: addendum_mm (blankAddendumWidth at the drawn depth; 0 for a blank cut to net shape)

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Material
calculators.description: The material of one part: the sheet its blank is nested on (true-shape, defaultUtilizationMethod TRUE_PART), shared by the blanks the sheet holds, at the material's price.

source.engine: gross_kg (the sheet's mass over the blanks nested on it)

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Hydroform tool
calculators.description: One hydroform tool (memory/Sheetmetal Hydroforming): its design hours, the spotting of its form and non-form areas (hours per square inch, sqmmPerSqin) and the machining of its form (cncMillingRates profiling, tblFinishingRate finishing), the tryout quality loops (numQualityLoops, each loop's setup, press demount, disassembly, inspection and reassembly hours; more for a high-strength material), the tool steel (a deep draw punch and draw ring, or a fluid cell form block and its holder) with its coating and heat treatment, and its capping tools; with the intensifier when the Cost Guide includes it, and profit and SG&A. Shop rates and tool steel: the Digital Factory USA Default tool shop.

source.engine: quality_loops (numQualityLoops by the sheet's thickness and the material's type)
tryout_multiplier (1 + highStrengthMaterialTryoutMultiplierPercentage / 100 for a high-strength material, else 1)
steel_price (the tool shop's default tool material)
capping_tools (holes the rubber is kept out of)

fields.name: Design Cost
fields.formula: ({Design Prep Hours} + {Form Design Hours} + {Modify Adjust Hours}) * {Design Rate}

fields.name: Spotting Hours
fields.formula: ({Form Area} * {Form Spotting Rate} + {Non-Form Area} * {Non-Form Spotting Rate}) / {Square Millimetres per Square Inch} * {Stations}

fields.name: Machining Hours
fields.formula: {Form Area} / {Profiling Rate} + {Finishing Hours per Square Inch} * {Form Area} / {Square Millimetres per Square Inch}

fields.name: Tryout Hours
fields.formula: {Quality Loops} * ({Loop Setup Hours} + {Loop Demount Hours} + {Loop Disassembly Hours} + {Loop Inspection Hours} + {Loop Reassembly Hours}) * {Tryout Multiplier}

fields.name: Steel Cost
fields.formula: {Steel Mass} * ({Steel Price} + {Coating Cost Factor} * {Coating Dial} + {Heat Treat Cost} * {Heat Treat Dial})

fields.name: Tool Subtotal
fields.formula: {Design Cost} + {Spotting Cost} + {Machining Cost} + {Tryout Cost} + {Steel Cost} + {Capping Cost}

calculators.name: Hydroforming - Tool life
calculators.description: Parts one hydroform tool forms: tblToolLife by the material's type (defaultToolLife when the type is not listed), times the life its coating gives (tblToolCoating; defaultToolingCoatingType, or highStrengthMatlToolingCoatingType for a material above highStrengthMatlThreshold).

source.engine: parts_per_tool (tblToolLife by the material's type, else defaultToolLife)
